retry_recovery.scope: Three generic temporary queues, typed recovery and due dates

interrupted_worker.scope: Real transaction death; full domain-worker kill/restart only mocked

duplicate_receipts.scope: Real processes, idempotence and conflict rejection

stale_leases.scope: Email coordinator stale lease only; all-queue OS lifecycle not established

sqlite_contention.scope: Concurrent process lock waits and two-connection timeout/rollback

cache_corruption.scope: Hash-tampered local source body never trusted

robots_changes.scope: Fresh robots deny blocks cached body

conditional_revalidation.scope: ETag/304 replay under injected HTTP; no real origin timing claim

process_concurrency.scope: Three distinct OS processes; denied loopback bind before audit guard; local filesystem only

cross_coordinator_host_budget.scope: Two clients with request cap 2 each perform 4 total requests; no aggregate host cap or atomic coordination

source_freshness.scope: Original capture time retained on revalidation; expiry creates new receipt

parser_replay.scope: Append-only source history and regional version reparse

disk_retention.scope: Disk usage measured; approved automatic retention cleanup/quotas not implemented or validated

backup_restore.scope: Temporary receipt DB integrity_check and logical dump equality only; whole capture/observation recovery not proven

suppression.scope: Research hold non-bypass regression only; no production outreach exercised
